comrades.jaymoskingdoms.hunt.out.0: Meat's low. I'll see what's out there.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.hunt.out.1: I'm going after something to eat.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.hunt.out.2: Keep the fire going. I'll be back with supper.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.hunt.back.0: Fresh kill. Someone get the knife.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.hunt.back.1: Here. That'll keep us a day or two.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.hunt.none.0: Nothing left to hunt round here. We've had it all.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.hunt.none.1: Not a hoof or a feather for miles.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.supper.none.1: Not a scrap left. We go to bed hungry.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.supper.short.2: There was none left for me.
spirits.jaymoskingdoms.starving.0: I can't remember the last time I ate.
spirits.jaymoskingdoms.starving.1: My legs won't hold me much longer.
spirits.jaymoskingdoms.starving.3: The little ones are crying from hunger.
